import {invoiceFixture}from'../support/h3-invoice-fixtures.ts';import {read,write}from'../support/h4-booking-preparation-isolated.ts';
import {test}from'node:test';import assert from'node:assert/strict';import {readFile,writeFile}from'node:fs/promises';import {spawnSync}from'node:child_process';import {createHash}from'node:crypto';
import {isolatedPreparation,preparationF23Migration}from'../support/h4-booking-preparation-isolated.ts';import {preparationFixture}from'../support/h4-booking-preparation-fixtures.ts';
import {cancelFixture}from'../support/h4-booking-preparation-f23-fixtures.ts';
test('F23 C16/C17 populated50 upgrade with actual DDL failure rollback retry and catalogue',async()=>{const h=await isolatedPreparation('crm_f23_upgrade',58304,false,false);try{
 const f=await preparationFixture(h);await f.confirm();await f.pay();await f.run(await f.command());const cancellation=await cancelFixture(h,f);await cancellation.applySequential();const bare=await preparationFixture(h),bareCancellation=await cancelFixture(h,bare);await bareCancellation.applySequential();const history=(await f.see())!.history;const invoice=await invoiceFixture(h),original=await invoice.document(),ctx={contextKind:'booking' as const,contextId:invoice.bookingId,purpose:'provider-invoice-documentary'},bytes=await h.objects.download(await h.auth(),read,original.objectVersionId,ctx);await h.invoices.apply(await h.auth(),write,await invoice.need());await h.invoices.apply(await h.auth(),write,await invoice.receive(original));await h.invoices.apply(await h.auth(),write,await invoice.review());
 const names=(await h.observer`select tablename from pg_tables where schemaname='crm_private'order by tablename`).map(x=>String(x.tablename));const snapshot=async()=>Object.fromEntries(await Promise.all(names.map(async name=>[name,(await h.observer.unsafe(`select to_jsonb(x)::text v from crm_private.${name} x order by to_jsonb(x)::text`)).map(x=>x.v)])));
 const catalog=async()=>({relations:await h.observer`select oid,relname,relowner,relacl,relrowsecurity,relforcerowsecurity from pg_class where relnamespace in(select oid from pg_namespace where nspname like'crm_%')order by oid`,functions:await h.observer`select oid,proname,proowner,proacl,proconfig,proargtypes::text,prorettype,provolatile,prosecdef,pg_get_functiondef(oid)body from pg_proc where prokind='f'and pronamespace in(select oid from pg_namespace where nspname like'crm_%')order by oid`,policies:await h.observer`select * from pg_policy order by oid`,triggers:await h.observer`select oid,tgrelid,tgname,tgfoid,tgtype,tgenabled from pg_trigger order by oid`,roles:await h.observer`select rolname,rolsuper,rolbypassrls,rolinherit,rolcreaterole,rolcreatedb from pg_roles order by rolname`,members:await h.observer`select * from pg_auth_members order by oid`});
 const before=await snapshot(),old=await catalog(),sql=await readFile('supabase/migrations/'+preparationF23Migration,'utf8');await assert.rejects(h.migration.unsafe(sql.replace('\ncommit;','\nselect 1/0;\ncommit;')),{code:'22012'});await h.migration.unsafe('rollback');assert.deepEqual(await snapshot(),before);assert.deepEqual(await catalog(),old);await h.migration.unsafe(sql);assert.deepEqual(await snapshot(),before);assert.deepEqual(await h.objects.download(await h.auth(),read,original.objectVersionId,ctx),bytes);const current=await catalog();
 assert.deepEqual(current.roles,old.roles);assert.deepEqual(current.members,old.members);for(const kind of ['relations','policies','triggers']as const)for(const row of old[kind])assert.deepEqual(current[kind].find(x=>x.oid===row.oid),row,kind+':'+row.oid);
 const adapted:string[]=[];for(const row of old.functions){const now=current.functions.find(x=>x.oid===row.oid)!;if(['booking_preparation_core','booking_preparation_read'].includes(String(row.proname))){assert.deepEqual({...now,body:row.body},row,'F23 adapted attributes preserved');assert.notEqual(now.body,row.body);adapted.push(String(row.proname));}else assert.deepEqual(now,row,'unchanged function '+row.proname);}
 assert.deepEqual(adapted.sort(),['booking_preparation_core','booking_preparation_read']);assert.equal((await f.see())!.phase,'Cancelada');assert.equal((await bare.see())!.phase,'Cancelada');assert.deepEqual((await f.see())!.history,history);assert.equal((await f.see())!.historicalPhase,'Confirmada operativamente');const result={fresh:'C16 separate fresh51 test',upgrade:'50→51 populated Cancelada/current and Confirmada/history',ddlRollback:true,retry:true,adapted,originalPrivateBytesSha256:createHash('sha256').update(bytes).digest('hex'),priorDataSha256:createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(before)).digest('hex'),priorCatalogSha256:createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(old)).digest('hex'),currentCatalogSha256:createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(current)).digest('hex')};console.log('F23 V-MIG',JSON.stringify(result));if(process.env.H4014_CAPTURE_DIR){await writeFile(process.env.H4014_CAPTURE_DIR+'/f23-vmig.json',JSON.stringify(result,null,2)+'\n');await writeFile(process.env.H4014_CAPTURE_DIR+'/f23-catalog-before.json',JSON.stringify(old,null,2)+'\n');await writeFile(process.env.H4014_CAPTURE_DIR+'/f23-catalog-after.json',JSON.stringify(current,null,2)+'\n');}
}finally{await h.close();}});
test('F23 C16/C18/C20 fresh51 authority privacy and official advisors exclusively loopback',async()=>{const h=await isolatedPreparation('crm_f23_advisors',58305);try{
 const f=await preparationFixture(h),c=await cancelFixture(h,f);await c.applyAll();await c.applied();assert.equal((await f.see())!.phase,'Cancelada');assert.equal((await f.see())!.history.length,0);
 await assert.rejects(h.runtime.unsafe('select * from crm_private.b04_preparation_evaluations'),{code:'42501'});await assert.rejects(h.runtime.unsafe("select crm_private.booking_preparation_inputs('"+f.bid+"'::uuid,'"+h.scope+"')"),{code:'42501'});
 assert.doesNotMatch(JSON.stringify(await f.see()),/private_ref|content_ref|cost_amount|storage_path/);
 const auth=await h.auth(),epochs=()=>h.observer`select to_jsonb(x)d from crm_private.identification_epochs x order by epoch_id`,before=await epochs();await h.migration`select crm_api.set_actor_enabled(${h.actorId}::uuid,false,'ready')`;try{await assert.rejects(h.preparation.read(auth,read,f.bid));assert.deepEqual(await epochs(),before);}finally{await h.migration`select crm_api.set_actor_enabled(${h.actorId}::uuid,true,'ready')`;}
 const args=['--yes','supabase@2.119.0','db','advisors','--db-url','postgresql://crm_h0_migration@127.0.0.1:58305/crm_f23_advisors?sslmode=disable','--type','all','--fail-on','error'],r=spawnSync('npx',args,{encoding:'utf8',timeout:45000}),status={cmd:'npx',args,status:r.status,signal:r.signal,error:r.error?.message??null};console.log('F23 advisors',r.stdout,r.stderr,JSON.stringify(status));if(process.env.H4014_CAPTURE_DIR){await writeFile(process.env.H4014_CAPTURE_DIR+'/f23-advisors.stdout.log',r.stdout??'');await writeFile(process.env.H4014_CAPTURE_DIR+'/f23-advisors.stderr.log',r.stderr??'');await writeFile(process.env.H4014_CAPTURE_DIR+'/f23-advisors.status.json',JSON.stringify(status,null,2)+'\n');}assert.equal(r.status,0);assert.deepEqual(JSON.parse(r.stdout).results,[]);
}finally{await h.close();}});
test('F23 C19 original50 migrations approved sources original expected matrix69 normative23 and corrective expected preserved',async()=>{const manifest=JSON.parse(await readFile('tests/fixtures/h4-021-f23/base-preservation.json','utf8'))as{sha256:Record<string,string>};for(const [path,sha]of Object.entries(manifest.sha256))assert.equal(createHash('sha256').update(await readFile(path)).digest('hex'),sha,path);const frozen=spawnSync('git',['show','bea403745b836fdca909211a46bdb2f58602fd13:specs/001-core-crm/expected-TSK-H4-020-021-F23.md']);assert.equal(frozen.status,0);assert.deepEqual(await readFile('specs/001-core-crm/expected-TSK-H4-020-021-F23.md'),frozen.stdout);});
